mapper.sql: p.promotion_id, p.store_id, p.promotion_no, p.promotion_name, p.promotion_type, p.discount_rate, p.threshold_amount, p.reduce_amount, p.gift_desc, p.scope_type, p.scope_value, p.member_level_ids, p.is_special_price, p.priority, p.start_time, p.end_time, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark
mapper.select: select , pb.activity_price as activity_price, pb.limit_qty as limit_qty from biz_promotion p left join biz_promotion_book pb on pb.promotion_id = p.promotion_id and pb.book_id = #{bookId} where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = 2 and (p.start_time is null or p.start_time <= #{nowTime}) and (p.end_time is null or p.end_time >= #{nowTime}) and ( p.scope_type = 1 or (p.scope_type = 2 and (p.scope_value = #{categoryId} or find_in_set(#{categoryId}, p.scope_value))) or (p.scope_type = 3 and (p.scope_value = #{bookId} or find_in_set(#{bookId}, p.scope_value))) or pb.rel_id is not null ) order by p.priority desc, p.promotion_id desc
select ifnull(auto_increment, 1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database()) and table_name = 'biz_promotion'

select from biz_promotion p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = 2 and p.promotion_id <> #{promotionId} and (#{startTime} is null or p.end_time is null or p.end_time >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or p.start_time is null or p.start_time <= #{endTime}) order by p.priority desc, p.promotion_id desc limit 10
